question: When a registry change would re-render a landed ROSTER row, which holds?

options.label: Re-render in that PR (Recommended)
options.consequence: the registry PR re-renders the affected rows and names them; the one further departure from as-asked; same rule whether a reference stops or starts resolving

options.label: Freeze at landing
options.consequence: a landed row keeps the rendering it landed with; the lane compares against a rendering pinned at landing

options.label: Refuse the change
options.consequence: a registry change that would alter a landed row is refused until the maintainer rules on that row
